page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud server built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. Compute processing is driven by 32 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz, complemented by 256 GB of system RAM. This provides a generous memory allocation of 8 GB per vCPU, well above typical compute-oriented ratios.

Hardware acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, featuring 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include local disk storage, meaning operating system disks and temporary storage must be provisioned through network-attached block storage. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 20 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

Architecturally, the pairing of 32 dedicated AMD cores, 256 GB of host RAM, and 48 GB of GPU memory favors memory-dense accelerated workloads. It is well matched for mid-sized large language model inference, AI image and video processing pipelines, batch data transformations, and computer vision tasks. The absence of local disk drives avoids paying for unneeded local storage capacity, though storage-intensive workloads remain dependent on external network throughput.
